Input tick.description:
In server authoritative movement mode the client supplies this in PlayerAuthInputPacket.
For any client-bound packets containing a tick, the server should supply the tick value corresponding to the most recently processed PlayerAuthInputPacket.
This allows the client to adjust any client predictions made while the packet was in flight.
If the packet is being sent to the client but not relating to data of the player or a client-predicted vehicle, it can be zero.
It is also acceptable to specify zero for players, although this may lead to minor visual flickers and less smooth application of CorrectPlayerMovePredictionPacket.

Verify the recipe net id is non-zero

Aux value.description: Item auxiliary/metadata value. Used to distinguish item variants. Ignored for block items where aux is always 0.

Block Runtime Id.description: Runtime block state ID associated with this item when it represents a block. Used to identify the exact block state placed when the item is used.

Id.description: Send fixed Id of 0 for invalid item

Net Id Variant.description: Optional network ID variant used to track item stack identity across client and server.

Stack size.description: The number of items in the stack. Must be within the item's allowed stack size range.

User Data Buffer.description: The @ItemInstanceUserData.html#ItemInstanceUserData@  binary blob encoded as a String, so it's unsigned varint length prefixed. Get all your nbt+property bytes, calculate the length, write that length, THEN write the data.

Item Use Transaction.description: The reflected item use transaction performed on this auth-input tick.

Legacy Request ID.description: The legacy item stack request id associated with this item interaction. Zero means no legacy request.

Legacy Set Item Slots.description: Only present when Legacy Request ID is valid. Lists container slots involved in the interaction.

Actions.description: List of inventory slot changes. Each action describes which container slot is changing and what the item descriptor transitions from and to.
Actions.x-runtime-constraint-description: Verify that the number of InventoryActions does not exceed 100

Bit Flags.title: InventorySourceFlags
Bit Flags.description: Source flags. Present only for WorldInteraction source type.

Container ID.description: Container window ID. Present only for ContainerInventory and NonImplementedFeatureTODO source types.

From Item.description: The item descriptor representing the state of the slot before this action.

Slot.description: The slot index within the source container.

Source.description: The inventory source identifying which container this action targets.

To Item.description: The item descriptor representing the desired state of the slot after this action.

Camera Orientation.description: The world space unit vector for the camera forward direction.

Client Predicted Vehicle.description: The client-predicted vehicle the player is riding. Present only when the Input Data flags indicate the player is in a vehicle.

Client Tick.description: Which simulation frame client is on.

Input Data.description: Bitset of per-tick input flags (jumping, sneaking, gliding, collisions, etc.). Each flag gates additional optional fields below.
Input Data.x-runtime-constraint-description: Verify input data entries are known, unique, and not deprecated

Input Mode.title: InputMode
Input Mode.description: The input device the player is using (mouse/keyboard, touch, gamepad, motion controller).

Interact Rotation.description: The rotation the player is looking for interactions.

Item Stack Request.description: Item stack request for this tick. Present only when the Input Data flags indicate a request occurred.

Item Use Transaction.description: Item use transaction for this tick. Present only when the Input Data flags indicate a transaction occurred.

Move Vector.description: The desired local space move direction of the player.

New Interaction Model.title: NewInteractionModel
New Interaction Model.description: The interaction model in use (classic, touch, or crosshair).

Play Mode.title: ClientPlayMode
Play Mode.description: The play mode (normal or one of the reality/VR modes).

Player Block Actions.description: Block actions performed this tick. Present only when the Input Data flags indicate block actions occurred.

items.x-runtime-constraint-description: Verify block actions are one of StartDestroyBlock, AbortDestroyBlock, StopDestroyBlock, CrackBlock, PredictDestroyBlock, or ContinueDestroyBlock

Player Head Rotation.description: Effectively the same as the Y component of Player Rotation.

Player Rotation.description: Orientation of the player at the start of the tick.

Pos Delta.description: Client predicted velocity at the end of the tick.

Position.description: Client predicted position at the end of the tick.

Raw Move Vector.description: Same as move vector but not affected by input permissions.

Vehicle Rotation.description: Rotation of the vehicle the player is in. Present only when the Input Data flags indicate the player is in a vehicle.
